title: Multi-Region Active-Active LLM HA/DR & Global Traffic Routing: Geo-Sticky Prefix Affinity & Cascading-Overload Prevention Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Single Region + Cold Pilot-Light DR (Attempts On-Demand GPU Scale-Up During Regional Outage)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: Regional GPU `OutOfStock` during cloud outages leaves DR unable to scale (40m+ outage!)

tiers.name: Tier 2: 100% Idle Hot-Standby GPU Cluster in Region B + DNS Failover (60s TTL, Cold KV Cache on Failover)
tiers.verdict: Wastes 100% of Region B GPUs 99.8% of the year ($460K/mo), and 0% KV hit rate on failover triggers a 34.2% prefill storm!

tiers.name: Tier 3: Naive Active-Active 50/50 Global Round-Robin (Scatters Multi-Turn Sessions Across Regions)
tiers.verdict: Fast failover (8.5s), but cross-region round-robin adds +65ms WAN RTT and halves multi-turn Prefix Cache hits

tiers.name: Tier 4: Active-Active Geo-Sticky Routing + Async Top-Prefix Warm Sync + Brownout Context Cap & PAYGO Escape Hatch
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 1.8s RTO, 0.0% cascading overload drop, 99.99% availability & $192K/mo TCO (-58.3% vs Tier 2)
